text: A tote with a listed empty weight of 1 kg might be worth testing with laptop carriers who say heavy totes hurt, as an alternative to switching to a backpack; whether it is more comfortable when loaded has not been tested.
scope_limits: Replaces C-0016 under contract 0.4. Listed weight, not measured; comfort with a laptop untested.

text: Days with a lighter load, when some people already switch to a smaller bag, might be a better first use case to test for the Lévant than heavy daily carry; this is untested.
scope_limits: Replaces C-0017 under contract 0.4; the commute-mode part is dropped because its premise is not approved.

text: Negative Reddit discussion of Nordace might cost conversions from cold traffic, because some would-be buyers say they held off after reading it; tote-specific proof such as warranty terms and owner reports over time might reduce that risk. Neither effect has been measured.
scope_limits: Replaces C-0047 and the brief's former statement that Reddit is the main commercial risk.

text: Showing owner reports of microfiber vegan-leather bags that lasted years might weaken the peeling worry for a tote whose body is listed as micro-fiber vegan leather; this is untested.
scope_limits: Replaces C-0044 under contract 0.4; the owner reports are about another brand's bags.
